queueProposal.summary: The active R34/R33 draw owner bypasses R30TryXyzrhw* and falls directly to the R29 trampoline. Restore the bounded XYZRHW pre-dispatch at the final owner before generic HUD/world dispatch, with handled-result semantics that cannot double draw.

R30ApplyStereoSkyGlow selects the intermediate texture opposite to the pass that actually contains the final blur output. One-step currently composites pre-blur bright extraction; two-step composites horizontal-only output instead of vertical-final output.

R33Dispatch classifies a screen-space pass, then R33TryHud immediately classifies the same draw again. For perspective flat effects this duplicates projection lookup and three GetRenderState calls. Thread the already-computed R30ScreenSpaceKind into R33TryHud.

DX9EX-SKYGLOW-001: Bright pass writes temp; horizontal blur writes reduced.
When effectiveTwoStep is false, compositeSource is temp, so horizontal blur output is skipped.
When effectiveTwoStep is true, vertical blur writes temp but compositeSource is changed to reduced, so vertical-final output is skipped.
The adjacent code comment says the vertical pass should be the composite source, contradicting the implementation.
